lines.source: Ural and Yoshigoe 2025, Sec. I, III-C (threat model)
lines.text: Your AI model has been stolen. It now runs inside someone else's product. How do you show it's yours?

lines.source: Sec. II-B (watermarks are embedded in the model, during training)
lines.text: You can't sign a model like a painting. A label added on top is simply cut off. So the signature has to be trained in.

lines.source: Sec. II-B (three families of model watermark)
lines.text: There are three places to hide it.

lines.source: Sec. II-B, IV-B (feature-trigger marks, verified with black-box access)
lines.text: One: in what the model says. It learns odd answers to a set of secret questions. Ask from the outside. One match could be luck. A whole set is not.

lines.source: Sec. IV-B, VI-J (parameter perturbation: two weights, near-zero cost, white-box)
lines.text: Two: in its numbers. A tiny pattern written into just a couple of them. It costs almost nothing, but you need the file in your hands to read it.

lines.source: Sec. IV-B, VI-J (auxiliary head: main task untouched, replaceable)
lines.text: Three: in a small extra part attached to the model, which normal use never touches. The model's work is barely disturbed, and the part can be replaced.

lines.source: Sec. II-B.1, VI-J (three families compared under one regime; deployment guidance)
lines.text: In our research we trained all three the same way and measured them. No single one wins. It depends on whether you can open the model, or only talk to it.

lines.source: Sec. II-C.1, III-C.5 (cleaning, fine-tuning and pruning attenuate a mark)
lines.text: And they share one weakness. A thief can retrain the model, or cut parts of it away, until the signature washes out.

lines.source: Sec. II-C.1, III-C.5 (removal alters the weight trajectory, so replay fails)
lines.text: So we tie the signature to the record of how the model was trained. Wash it out, and the model no longer matches its own record.
AI models are becoming property. And property needs a signature that survives being copied.
